gamerule.mcrl.step_up.description: Cars climb full-block steps (half-block steps, slabs and stairs always work)
mcrl.command.no_room: No room for a car here
mcrl.physics.remote: On a server, /mcrl physics status shows the physics
mcrl.physics.off_refused: Physics is off: turn it on in mcrl settings (M) > Physics
mcrl.physics.last_crash: Last session crashed in mcrl physics: %s at section %s %s %s
mcrl.crash.title: mcrl: the last session crashed
mcrl.crash.body: Minecraft stopped while mcrl's physics was busy (%s at section %s %s %s).

mcrl.settings.title: mcrl settings
mcrl.settings.physics.tooltip: Off: cars and the ball stay where they are and do not move. Use it if Minecraft crashes in mcrl's physics.
mcrl.settings.physics.remote: Physics runs on the server here
mcrl.settings.online.status.local: Single player: the physics runs in this game

mcrl.settings.arena_status_none: Stadium arena: none (convert the stadium or set the folder)
mcrl.match.exists: A match is on already: /mcrl match join

mcrl.match.already_in: You are in the match already
mcrl.match.not_allowed: Only the match's creator or an operator can do that
mcrl.match.not_in: You are not in the match
mcrl.match.no_free_play: The stadium is for matches: use /mcrl match
mcrl.settings.steps_always: Slabs and stair steps are always climbable.
mcrl.settings.no_mcrl_server: This server does not run mcrl
mcrl.settings.car.scan: Find bodies in my RL install
mcrl.settings.car.status.unavailable: Drawn as the Octane until converted from your RL install

mcrl.settings.hud_hide_vanilla: Hide hotbar and bars while driving
mcrl.settings.sound.dynamics.tooltip: RL's ducking and HDR mix, approximated. Off plays RL's fixed levels.

mcrl.setup.convert_off: Conversion is off in this client (-Dmcrl.rlconvert=off)

gamerule.mcrl.surface_physics.descriptio: Ice, slime, honey and soul sand change how cars and the ball move

gamerule.mcrl.ball_hits_entities.descrip: The ball knocks mobs, players and items, and they slow it down
